text: Thus, the ten indriyas have been explained by the distinction between the faculty of intellect (buddhi) and the faculties of action (karmendriyas). As for the mind (manas), which is the eleventh, what is its nature and what is its essential form? This is stated as follows: The mind is of a dual nature; it is both the faculty of deliberation (sankalpa) and an indriya, by virtue of its similarity (to the other indriyas).
